reviews.text: Thank you for your positive feedback! ⭐ Our team strives to provide quality care and attentive service with every visit. Knowing that your experience was positive makes us very happy. We look forward to serving you again!
Thank you so much, Ms. Guėrin, for your kind review! We sincerely appreciate your support and trust in our team.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this clinic. My experience was negative for both my dog ​​and me.

During my first few appointments, I had a very good experience with a veterinarian who took the time to let my dog ​​get used to her before proceeding with the examination. This was particularly important since my dog ​​had a difficult start in life and has trouble trusting new people. He is also very nervous despite his medication.

At a subsequent appointment, without any prior notice, we were seen by a different veterinarian. I explained the situation and asked him to take a few minutes to allow my dog ​​to get used to him before the examination. Despite this, he immediately attempted to take my dog's temperature rectally. My dog ​​was clearly showing signs of stress and discomfort, but several attempts were made nonetheless. Ultimately, the examination couldn't be completed, and my dog ​​wasn't able to receive his vaccinations or have a full health assessment.

Today, I had a second, particularly frustrating experience.

My appointment was at 3:20 p.m., and I arrived at 3:28 p.m. I acknowledge my lateness and fully understand that it may have impacted the clinic's schedule.

However, at 3:23 p.m., while I was parking my car, the clinic called to confirm my arrival. I was told that their policy allowed for a delay of up to 10 minutes. I explained that I was still parking and would arrive before 3:30 p.m. I was assured that I could proceed to my appointment. I apologized and thanked the receptionist.

At 3:28 p.m., while I was at the door, I was finally called and informed that they wouldn't be taking my dog. A veterinarian then came out to explain the situation.

What I find particularly problematic is the inconsistency between the two communications: a few minutes earlier, I had been told I could arrive until 3:30 p.m., then, at 3:28 p.m., they refused to see me. I simply would have liked to receive clear and consistent information from the start.

The veterinarian also reassured me by saying that I wouldn't be charged for today's appointment. I find this perfectly reasonable since no consultation took place and I arrived within the lateness period the clinic had given me.

When I asked why the stated policy didn't apply in my case, I was instead criticized for a previous same-day cancellation. This cancellation was exceptional and, more importantly, had nothing to do with the lateness policy we were discussing. I was also charged an unpaid invoice of $50, which corresponded precisely to the cancellation fee and which I had come to pay during that appointment. After two years as a client, and having always paid for my services on the same day, I found this way of presenting the situation particularly unpleasant.

In the end, I had rented a car, given my dog ​​his medication, and taken the afternoon off work to attend the appointment. Yes, I was 8 minutes late, but I was still within the 10-minute grace period that had been communicated to me just a few minutes earlier.

What disappoints me most is less the fact that the appointment was refused than the way the situation was handled: contradictory information, a lack of consideration for my dog's circumstances, and questioning my reliability as a client to justify a decision that didn't align with the policy I had been informed of.

After this experience, I have unfortunately lost confidence in this clinic for my dog's care.
Thank you so much for your trust! 🐾 It's a pleasure to work with you and your companion. …
A medicine for ear infection that I can buy on-line (with a prescription) for $61 delivered, this clinic charged us $132. On top of a remarkable charge for a rabies update. Au secours! Voleurs!

My first couple of interactions with this clinic were good. However, I have now been waiting two weeks for the results of blood tests on my ill animal that should have been provided to me within a few days. I have called twice, and have been told that the vet will get back to me, and am still waiting for a response. There has been no follow-up on my pet's condition, even though I only left the clinic with six days of medication 14 days ago. When paying over $400 for blood tests, is it too much to ask to have the results communicated to me within a reasonable amount of time? Even if there is nothing conclusive, it would still be good to know. I am very disappointed. I live with two animals that are now considered "seniors". Their care needs are likely to increase substantially. I'm not sure that I should trust their care to this clinic any more.

I want to thank the clinic staff from the bottom of my heart, especially Dr. Maria Koprowska, for taking care of my 13-year-old cat, Pelusa. We’re both Cuban immigrants, so having the support and excellent care from everyone at the clinic has made us feel very loved. I hope to continue counting on your help, and I’d like to highly recommend this wonderful team. Thank you very much from Pelusa, my wife, and me.
Thank you so much for your excellent review ⭐️ We are delighted to have been able to care for your pet. We look forward to seeing you again at the clinic!
Thank you for these 5 stars, it's a real encouragement for our entire team. We remain committed to the well-being of your companions and thank you for your loyalty 🐾 …

This was the first clinic I went to, and I encountered some truly competent people at the beginning, who were attentive and non-judgmental. The reception staff are very friendly. My last appointment for my cat was for her outdoor vaccinations, and I saw a vet who completely judged me and told me it was like leaving a two-year-old unsupervised. I fully understand the differing opinions regarding letting pets go outside. However, as a professional, I feel it's necessary to maintain a certain distance and respect what the patient says. I mentioned to him that my cat came from a place where she had outdoor access, and he offered to give her medication to "calm her down." I'm sorry, but at no point did I say I didn't want to let my cat go outside. He implied that she would die young, and his body language spoke volumes. I decided to leave this clinic because I felt this veterinarian prioritized his personal opinions too much, and he made me feel guilty. I left feeling very angry. The intention here wasn't to start a debate; I understand the risks involved, but there's a right way and a wrong way to communicate them, and this veterinarian has neither!
Good vet, good advice, and courteous staff. I recommend them.
Good service, friendly staff, good veterinarians

I'm not satisfied with the last appointment because the vet didn't take my cat's temperature, didn't weigh him, and didn't offer any advice after a year.

It's a shame Dr. Gélinas isn't there anymore because I used to receive good service.

I've been a client for over eight years for my dog. In the beginning, everything was great. Over time, I even developed relationships with some of the team members. It was a clinic I truly enjoyed going to because my needs were always heard and considered, even though I can spend up to $8,000 a year on my beloved pet. But for a little over a year now, the clinic has completely changed its approach to clients. The friendly staff is gone. Now, they try to sell me unnecessary services or "extras." My dog's medical file is never understood when I arrive. The opening hours have become so limited that I have to leave work to get an appointment. The reception staff speak to each other in English, even though they also speak French very well; there are no smiles, no joy in their work. For me, Beaubien Clinic is finished. Many other clinics in the neighborhood are more pleasant, less expensive, and more honest about their services.
Thank you for your review! We do our best to provide the best care that each of our clients and their furry friends needs and deserves. We hope to see you again soon. ⭐️

I want to share my very disappointing experience with the Beaubien Veterinary Clinic.

I arrived from France with my cat, whose medical care was extremely rigorous: arthritis, hyperthyroidism, dental and heart problems. Her complete and detailed file (prescriptions, x-rays, diagnoses) had been sent to the clinic.

Living in nearby Montreal, I chose this clinic for its accessibility and remained a loyal patient for several months. However, when my cat began to show worrying signs—loss of appetite, obvious pain in her mouth, behaviors typical of dental resorption already diagnosed in France—I quickly made an appointment.

Unfortunately, the consultation with Dr. Gj was very disappointing. Despite my clear explanations at the beginning of the appointment and the fact that my pet's complete file was available in their system, it was obvious that it hadn't been reviewed. The doctor rattled off medical terms and hypotheses unrelated to the situation, without truly listening.

I was offered a skull X-ray, followed by an additional charge for its interpretation by another veterinarian (???). It was only after insisting that my cat's teeth were finally examined—even though that was precisely the reason for my visit.

I left with a $715 bill, without a clear diagnosis or treatment plan. I felt completely neglected. It seems essential to me that a doctor review their patient's file before taking any action or prescribing anything.

In comparison, I thank the Royal Vet clinic in Rosemont for their professionalism: prompt service, a dedicated veterinarian, attentive listening, and a clear diagnosis made simply by examining the teeth. My cat ultimately had several teeth extracted due to advanced resorption, which confirmed that the problem had been correctly identified.

A frustrating, costly, and avoidable experience.
The staff were courteous, professional and attentive to my pet's needs.
I have been a client for over 20 years and the people at this clinic, veterinarians, assistants, receptionists, are extraordinary.
Excellent staff, reasonable prices compared to the market
Easily one of the best veterinary clinic in Montreal. Everyone in there is very helpful and most important of all, genuinly caring to our furry friends.
I've been coming here for years and I'm changing clinics. Disrespect and condescension are what you can expect now. You never see the same vet twice, so they don't care about treating you properly.

We've been going to Beaubien Veterinary Clinic for several years now, and honestly, the quality of service has really deteriorated. There's always a new vet, no one really knows our cat's file, and we always have to explain the entire history from scratch.

Our cat is very anxious, and we always ask for gabapentin before appointments. This time, they made us bring him in... only to tell us there that they couldn't do the examination without gabapentin and that we had to come back later. The result: a wasted trip, a stressed cat for no reason, no examination done, and a bill of about $300 to... leave just as we arrived.

To top it all off, they even referred us to another clinic.

After so long as loyal clients, it's really disappointing. We no longer feel confident or cared for. We're going to have to change clinics.
Hello, we are sorry to hear that your visit did not meet your expectations. Please feel free to let us know what we can do to improve.
We are pleased to know that you are satisfied with our care. We are always there for you and your pet, whatever the need.
Great clinic!

My dog ​​had been going to the Beaubien Veterinary Clinic for several years. Dr. Gélinas, an exceptional veterinarian, treated my dog, who has numerous health problems. Unfortunately, she retired. She was the only reason I continued going there. The clinic only cares about money and not at all about the well-being of our animals. First of all, even speaking to someone on the phone is complicated or takes a long time; getting an appointment takes forever, so it's impossible to get a consultation in the following weeks if your pet needs it. No effort will be made to try to accommodate you. The cost… $43 to express glands instead of $15 at the new vet I go to (in Montreal), that's just one example. Take the time to call elsewhere to compare prices. I'm willing to pay more for good service, but that's definitely not the case here. High cost and poor service. Despite speaking with the manager, I can't get prescriptions for my dog's medication because I have to pay. I imagine the response to my comment will be that these are medication preparation costs, because that's what I'm being told. What's wrong is simply sending the prescription, because everything is documented in his file and there's no need for reassessment since he just had his appointment in July. So, my dog ​​has prescriptions from an appointment he had, and they refuse to give them to me. I spend several hundred dollars a month at this clinic (appointments, medication, food, teeth cleaning, etc.) and there's absolutely NO empathy or interest in my dog's well-being, let alone any interest in providing good customer service. I imagine the response to my comment will be some flimsy excuse, but I simply advise you to verify the lack of service and the unjustified costs for yourself.
I've been buying specialized cat food for 10 years, but lately you absolutely have to give your name to buy it... on principle I refuse and will spend my $150 in my pocket on Amazon...
Thank you so much for your perfect score, Ms. Trofimoff 🙏⭐ …
Thank you for your review! We do our best to provide the best care that each of our clients and their furry friends needs and deserves. We hope to see you again soon. ⭐️

I no longer recommend this clinic, which is now part of the Daubigny Veterinary Group (the group owns "more than 100 clinics in Canada" according to its website). Making an appointment is a hassle (you receive saccharine automated emails reminding you to book, but when you call, you're curtly told to call back in several weeks!), the wait is long, and explanations are sparse. The atmosphere in the clinic is cold, even tense. It's night and day compared to the close, understanding, and warm care I received in 2018 for my cat, who was very ill and ultimately passed away.

Several bad episodes there. Just overall not impressed and not helpful. Not customer oriented nor very pet friendly.
We changed vet.

We were fortunate enough to have our pets (cats and dogs) treated at this clinic for about fifteen years. Special mention goes to Dr. Gélinas, now retired, but all the staff we encountered were competent and welcoming. We now have to change clinics due to a move, but I recommend them without hesitation! Thank you for your excellent care!

We have a file with this clinic for routine checkups, vaccinations, medications, etc. Our dog fell and injured himself; we were offered an appointment 13 days later—nothing sooner. Unfortunately, we can't rely on this clinic.
The staff were very kind and helpful, the vet explained things well to us, perfect and thank you!

I've been taking my dog ​​to this clinic for over eight years, but my last experience was unacceptable. My dog ​​needed urgent care, and when I called, the technician, Catherine (or Katerina), refused to give me an appointment for two weeks. She showed no empathy and made no attempt to find a solution. The service was cold and inconsiderate. If you care about your pet, I do not recommend this clinic.

It takes forever to get an appointment. And their hours keep getting shorter. They decided to stop opening on Saturdays. Then they decided to close at 6:00 PM (before, they were open until 7:30 PM on Wednesdays and Thursdays). And now, surprise surprise, they're closed on Fridays too! A veterinary clinic should offer a schedule that allows employees to go without having to take time off work. This is ridiculous.
Thank you! We are thrilled to be able to offer the best service to all our customers! 🐾 …
Thank you, we are thrilled to be able to offer the best service to all our customers! 🐾 …
clinic is too busy to provide any kind of customer service. I phoned many times, no one will answer during open hours, always directed to voice mail. don't waste your time here.
Thank you so much for this positive feedback 💬😊 Your satisfaction (and that of your animals!) is our greatest reward. …

It's impossible to get an appointment for an emergency; the wait is 3 to 6 weeks. They run a battery of expensive tests without providing follow-up or results. My dog ​​developed lymphoma, and they didn't follow up. I had to go to a specialist and repeat tests to get a diagnosis. The manager isn't a veterinarian and provides terrible service.
I'll never go back, even though it's just a stone's throw from my home.
Ms. Harvey, thank you for the 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Your rating speaks for itself, and we sincerely appreciate it.

This morning I had to have my life partner, Lyla, euthanized.

I met an extraordinary team, compassionate and attentive. Thank you for all the little things that made this difficult moment easier.
Thank you for this wonderful review! Your trust means a great deal to us, and we will continue to go the extra mile to provide you with exceptional service.
Amazing!!
Amilie at reception answered my call; she provided excellent service with a smile in her voice 😁 I've always dealt with Dr. Gelinas, the best vet in town!! 10/10 …
I received impeccable service from the technicians, secretaries, and veterinarians. They were always attentive and non-judgmental. I couldn't have asked for better.
It's important to us to care for animals as well as their owners. We're happy to know you enjoyed your experience with our team. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to call us!

The whole team is incredibly kind, gentle, understanding of our concerns, and makes us feel that they will take good care of our animals even in our absence! The atmosphere is calmer than in other clinics, which is great for anxious animals (and owners).
Attentive service for our dogs. Good follow-up by phone when needed, despite the high volume of customers.

I want to say only good things about this vet office, but I have had multiple bad experiences - most recently, I don’t feel like my cat’s needs were met while hospitalized because of their poor internal communication, and during a private consultation AND during euthanasia with the same vet tech, I felt odd hostility (she refused to speak to me in French, even though I spoke French with her during every interaction) and she was very defensive about some of my questions. I think the language barrier is partially to blame, so I need to acknowledge this. But considering my experience last night, putting down my most cherished companion while in their care, I felt robbed of such an important moment because of the vet tech’s clumsiness and unprofessionalism.

As well, they are training a new employee who made both my boyfriend and I very uncomfortable with her mannerisms (performative coughing at the ceiling?!) and in December of 2023, the vet was working while sick, wearing a mask, and  unknowingly transmitted covid to me. I’m sure they are lovely, hardworking people, all of them, but I am very unhappy with how my cat and I were treated.
Good customer service

This is an excellent team that truly cares about animal health, and it shows. We had our two cats neutered, and from start to finish, we were kept well-informed at every step. The whole team did a fantastic job, which made the entire process much less stressful.

Excellent service and support from the entire team, both at reception and during veterinary consultations. A special thank you to Dr. Luis and Emilie (technician) for their patience and incredible follow-up! :)
Thank you for the 5 stars and your positive feedback!
Thank you so much for these 5 stars! 🌟 Your trust is a great source of motivation for our team. …

My old cat Woopa is 11 years old and has hated going to the vet since he was a kitten. He's always terrified and howls as if his heart (and mine at the same time!) is being ripped out. As his owner, it's torture to witness this... But I've found a team at this clinic with incredible patience and dedication. Every time, the receptionist is lovely, available, and gives excellent advice. Dr. Gélinas is a gem of gentleness, patience, and delicacy, and she manages to do with Woopa what no other vet has ever been able to do (all while being yelled at by a very disgruntled cat). The technicians maintain their humanity even in difficult moments, like when they had to restrain my cat for a blood test. Restraining someone with firmness and gentleness, in perfect balance—that takes skill, doesn't it?

In short, I feel lucky and deeply grateful to have found this team, including every single staff member... It's a gift for Woopa.

And all this effort and work in a context where the team regularly faces the anger and grief of worried or bereaved owners, sometimes receiving a lot of understandable aggression from someone who is suffering... Well done for persevering, well done for continuing to believe in what you do, and thank you for being there for our animals.

Thank you (even if Woopa doesn't like you very much 🤭 😆)!!
